summary: W30 stages the character page, fixed widget bindings, layout and previously published status content before replacing its root. The host borrows the page screen and obtains its current widget root for routing. Search text, scroll position and preview angles survive replacement. Status rows stage changes before publication, retire removed children and shrink their child backing. The shared scroll layout uses its existing owned children and allocates no temporary pointer array. A normal character refresh uses one snapshot for labels, the appearance draft and the preview. Preview cache metadata is staged before GL texture replacement, and the old texture is retired after publication. The independent Release fixture checks every observed initial and replacement allocation refusal, status growth and shrink refusals, and retirement. All 46 Release regression groups, the fingerprint test, both native appearance layouts, and the existing 72 layouts, 10 window actions and 209 inventory icon checks pass in their scoped fixtures. Remaining catalog shell, snapshot source composition, preview resource and full S0–S6 acceptance remain open.
